content: {"like":["Enjoys family‑friendly, humorous fantasy films with strong voice acting and memorable characters","Prefers a blend of CGI and traditional 2D animation, often with eye‑popping 3D effects","Values well‑crafted storytelling, character development, and rewatchable content","Appreciates musical elements that are catchy and performed by professional singers","Looks for high production quality, widescreen presentation, and extras on making of the film"],"dislike":["Dislikes plot holes, contradictory storytelling, and uninteresting characters","Avoids films with poor voice acting, flat performances, or low sound quality","Prefers not to watch movies that are too long or too short, or that lack depth","Rejects releases that are not anniversary editions or that have technical issues like loading problems","Steers clear of content that is too adult‑oriented or not suitable for all ages"]}
